$comment: New | Mateu file kinds — the SINGLE source shared by the IntelliJ plugin (New | Mateu group) and the VS Code extension (Mateu: New File…, staged by scripts/prepackage.mjs). Each `template` names a skeleton at fileTemplates/internal/<template>.yaml.ft. Placeholders: __TITLE__ (title derived from the file name), __NAME__ (file base name) and a line holding only __PAGE_WIDTH__ (replaced by a root `style:` for the chosen page width, or removed). Every skeleton is validated against backend/shared/uidl/specs-schema.json by NewMateuFileSkeletonsTest.

files.label: UI Mount
files.description: A UI served at a base path (type: UI) — the data-driven equivalent of @UI. Lists its route files.

files.label: Routes File
files.description: The route registry of a mount (type: Routes), created EMPTY and registered in the mount's routes list. Add its entries one at a time with Add Route…

files.label: App Shell
files.description: The app chrome (type: AppShell): title, menu and home route. Bind it to the mount root ("") in routes.yaml.

files.label: REST Source Catalogue
files.description: Named REST endpoints (type: Sources) that pages reference by name instead of repeating URLs.

files.label: Field Types
files.description: Reusable field/column definitions (type: Types) that fields and columns reference with fieldType: <id>.

files.label: Page…
files.description: A page / component definition, started from a page template.

pageTemplates.label: Form
pageTemplates.description: A titled form: fields in a responsive layout and a Save button.

pageTemplates.label: Listing / CRUD
pageTemplates.description: A searchable, filterable table over a REST source, with New and a row route to the record.

pageTemplates.label: Wizard step
pageTemplates.description: One step of a guided process: progress, the step's fields, Back / Next.

pageTemplates.label: Dashboard
pageTemplates.description: A KPI band (scoreboard of metric cards) over a grid of titled panels.

pageTemplates.label: Smart Search
pageTemplates.description: A search-first page: an intro line over the smart search bar and its results.

pageTemplates.label: To-do List
pageTemplates.description: Pending work as counted buckets of cards; clicking a card acts on it.

pageTemplates.label: Calendar
pageTemplates.description: A calendar toolbar (previous / today / next / create) over a month grid of events.

pageTemplates.label: Welcome
pageTemplates.description: A hero with calls to action over highlight tiles.

pageTemplates.label: Hero Search
pageTemplates.description: A centered hero with the search, results as cards below.

pageTemplates.label: Collection Detail
pageTemplates.description: A list of items on the left, the selected item's detail on the right.

pageTemplates.label: General Overview
pageTemplates.description: A record switcher on top and the record's overview: header, facts and property cards.

pageTemplates.label: Item Overview
pageTemplates.description: A key-info panel on the left and tabs with the rest of the record on the right.

pageTemplates.label: Foldout
pageTemplates.description: An always-visible overview with lateral fold-out panels.

pageTemplates.label: Gantt Page
pageTemplates.description: A title over a Gantt timeline of tasks.

pageTemplates.label: Data Management
pageTemplates.description: The same records as a grid or as a Gantt, switched with tabs.

pageTemplates.label: Matrix Grid
pageTemplates.description: Rows of metrics in sections against date columns, editable in place.

pageTemplates.label: Planning Board
pageTemplates.description: Resources by days (a tape chart) with draggable blocks.

pageTemplates.label: Blank layout
pageTemplates.description: An empty vertical layout to build from scratch in the visual editor.
